verdict.rationale: Docs show a broad API/apps framework (agents run programmatically, webhooks, granular scopes, custom views/widgets, MCP) implying deep API coverage, but there is no explicit claim or evidence of full UI-API parity, and no independent confirmation that every UI action is API-exposed. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, third-party verification that all UI features (e.g. board configuration, permissions, views) are fully scriptable via API.
